items.title: Amazon Alexa can now alert you when something new might tempt you to shop
items.summary: Amazon is adding a new Alexa-powered feature called “Update Me When” that can send personalized alerts about product launches, tours, books, shows, and other events that could trigger a purchase.

items.title: AIR raises $50M to help companies vet the skills and add-ons AI agents use
items.summary: AIR's platform can discover agents running at a company, continuously vets any skills and add-ons they use, and blocks any unwanted behaviour.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage drags on, but things are improving
items.summary: Microsoft 365 and Outlook are still seeing service degradations on Tuesday, the company's status page indicates.

items.title: Fambot introduces an ‘AI chief of staff’ for families
items.summary: Fambot is building an AI “chief of staff” to help families manage the emails, calendars, school updates, sports schedules, and other logistics of raising kids.

items.title: Florida and Texas move to block Flock cameras over privacy concerns
items.summary: Flock's searchable network of 130,000 license plate cameras around the U.S. have sparked bipartisan privacy and civil liberties concerns.

items.title: This startup is fuel-injecting hydrogen to make cargo ships more efficient
items.summary: Newlight has raised a $9 million seed round and completed an 8,500-nautical-mile test run from Singapore to Ghana.

items.title: Waymo accelerates robotaxi expansion with launches in Denver, San Diego and Tampa
items.summary: Waymo will begin inviting riders on a rolling basis and slowly ramp up access in the three cities, following its usual commercial playbook.

items.title: Help build the future of startups: Volunteer at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt is where those moments happen. And we can't pull it off without volunteers like you.

items.title: India’s Unacademy sells to rival upGrad for $206M, about 94% less than its peak valuation
items.summary: "We raised at a peak, but sold at a fraction of that," Unacademy co-founder and CEO Gaurav Munjal wrote. "I'm not going to dress these facts up."

items.title: If space data centers feel far-fetched, why not interstellar travel?
items.summary: The team behind Starcloud's orbital data centers has a new high-risk space project: Sending a probe to Alpha Centauri.

items.title: Magna increases bet on battery swapping in India with $35M for Yuma
items.summary: Magna's investment in Yuma Energy has reached $87 million as the Canadian auto supplier increases its majority stake in the Indian battery-swapping firm.

items.title: Lachy Groom backs Indian startup aiming to keep aircraft aloft for a year
items.summary: Founded by a 20-year-old, Alteon is developing autonomous aircraft that hopes to harvest wind energy to stay aloft for several months.

items.title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
items.summary: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.

items.title: Polymarket reportedly raises $300 million from Donald Trump Jr.’s investment fund
items.summary: The firm, 1789 Capital, led the funding round that reportedly will total around $1 billion.

items.title: a16z brings growth fund to $8.5B days after launching new $1.1B fund
items.summary: Andreessen Horowitz held out its hand and returned with billions more in new funds to invest in startups.

items.title: A group funded by Andreessen, Horowitz, and Brockman plans data center ads to sway midterms
items.summary: Build American AI plans to lobby voters in select states about the virtues of data centers by spending millions of dollars on ads.

items.title: FTC accuses Amazon of running a ‘secret ad surcharge scheme’ in new lawsuit
items.summary: Amazon is facing a new lawsuit from the FTC and 22 states for allegedly secretly charging businesses more for advertising.

items.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
items.summary: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.

items.title: Apply now to host a Side Event at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: Apply before September 4 to be a part of the TechCrunch Disrupt community by hosting your own Side Event.

items.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
items.summary: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.
